```sql
SELECT 
    o.region,
    SUM(o.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders o
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE 
    d.date_day = '2026-01-01'
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    o.region;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    o.region,
    SUM(o.net_revenue_eur) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders o
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE 
    d.calendar_year = 2025
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    o.region
ORDER BY 
    o.region;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    o.region,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders o
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE 
    d.calendar_year = 2026 
    AND d.calendar_month = 5
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    o.region;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM analytics.fct_orders
JOIN analytics.dim_date ON analytics.fct_orders.order_date_local = analytics.dim_date.date_day
WHERE analytics.dim_date.calendar_month = 5 
  AND analytics.dim_date.calendar_year = 2026;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    p.category,
    SUM(ol.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM 
    analytics.fct_order_lines ol
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
    analytics.fct_orders f ON ol.order_id = f.order_id
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON f.order_date_local = d.date_day
WHERE 
    d.calendar_year = 2025
    AND f.status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    p.category
ORDER BY 
    units_sold DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM analytics.fct_orders
WHERE order_date_local >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date_local < '2026-01-01'
  AND status != 'cancelled';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    o.country,
    SUM(o.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders o
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON o.order_date_local = d.date_day
WHERE 
    d.calendar_year = 2025
GROUP BY 
    o.country
ORDER BY 
    net_revenue DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(fr.amount_eur) AS refunded_eur
FROM analytics.fct_refunds fr
JOIN analytics.fct_orders fo ON fr.order_id = fo.order_id
WHERE fo.order_date_local >= '2026-03-01' AND fo.order_date_local < '2026-04-01';
```
